Markets.title: ESDS blockbuster debut drives 5.19% surge in Motilal Oswal Digital India Fund
Markets.summary: ESDS Software's stock more than doubled on its market debut, driving a rare 5.19% surge in the Motilal Oswal Digital India Fund's net asset value. The fund manager highlighted strong performance from the IPO's anchor allocation, with potential for further NAV increases.

Markets.title: Stocks in news: Swiggy, M&M, REC, Adani Power and Bajaj Finserv
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets closed lower on Monday, extending a four-week losing streak amid rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions. Meanwhile, companies like Swiggy, Mahindra & Mahindra, REC, Adani Power, and Bajaj Finserv made notable business and market news.

Markets.title: Pre-market action: Here's the trade setup for today's session
Markets.summary: Indian benchmark indices opened flat and remained under pressure, with analysts suggesting the Nifty's immediate bias remains down. Meanwhile, the India VIX rose significantly to indicate market anxiety while foreign and domestic institutional investors were net buyers.

Markets.title: Fairfax plans IIFL Finance exit to fund IDBI Bank bid
Markets.summary: Fairfax Financial Holdings plans to sell its stake in IIFL Finance to help fund its proposed acquisition of IDBI Bank. Following the takeover, Fairfax intends to merge CSB Bank with IDBI Bank to simplify its lending operations and eliminate business overlaps.

Markets.title: Indian firms line up $7.7 billion in ECB proposals in July
Markets.summary: In July, Indian companies filed $7.70 billion in external commercial borrowing proposals, marking a 27% increase from the previous month. This surge follows the Reserve Bank of India's easing of its borrowing framework in February, with Air India and InterGlobe Aviation seeking $780 million under special permissions.

Markets.title: RBI easing drives Indian companies’ $7.70 billion overseas borrowing
Markets.summary: Indian companies filed proposals for $7.70 billion in external commercial borrowings in July, marking a 27% increase from the previous month. This growth followed the Reserve Bank of India's decision earlier this year to ease its borrowing framework by increasing caps and removing cost ceilings.

Geo-Political.title: Flight recorders recovered from 'devastating' Amazon cargo plane crash
Geo-Political.summary: Flight recorders were recovered after a Boeing 767-300 cargo plane crashed in the Amazon. The accident resulted in five deaths and five serious injuries.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
Geo-Political.summary: A headteacher in the occupied West Bank has installed new barbed wire fencing after three pupils were killed this year.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
Geo-Political.summary: After winning a state election, Germany's far-right AfD party claimed that democracy requires other political parties to cooperate with them. The party fell three seats short of a legislative majority and is currently attempting to form a state government.

Geo-Political.title: Eiffel Tower shut by staff protest after female workers moved for religious visit
Geo-Political.summary: Staff shut down the Eiffel Tower in protest after female employees were moved to accommodate a religious visit. The mayor of Paris announced an investigation into the incident following union reports that the workers felt humiliated.

Geo-Political.title: Trump threatens to stop sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in US
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump threatened to block the sale of Canadian Bombardier jets in the United States. This threat stems from an escalating trade war between the US and Canada.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of  'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of people attended the funeral in Serbia for Ratko Mladić, a convicted war criminal known as the "Butcher of Bosnia." Mladić was jailed for genocide during the 1990s Bosnian war, and the European Union had warned Serbia against glorifying him.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A digital marketer recently discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top organic search result without any paid advertising. Data & Insights.title: India plans to pool factory energy demand to power a green switch
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government plans to aggregate factory energy demand to make bulk purchases of green power. This initiative aims to secure better prices, lower emissions, and reduce energy costs for manufacturers.

Data & Insights.title: CII business confidence rebounds in Q2 on improving demand, hiring and investment outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in the second quarter of fiscal 2027. This rebound was driven by stronger domestic demand, increased capacity utilization, and an improved outlook for hiring and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Tech glitch or weak demand? Conflicting claims emerge as RBI launches another liquidity withdrawal op; check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is holding a 5 trillion rupee Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction on September 7. This follows a previous longer-tenor auction that received only 2.59 trillion rupees in bids amid conflicting claims over tech glitches and weak demand.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting postponed to 7 October from 12 September
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting has been rescheduled from 12 September to 7 October. Ahead of this meeting, preparatory sessions for government officers will take place on 5 and 6 October.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the era of cheap money is ending
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's Ratings reports that a shift toward higher interest rates is ending the era of cheap money. This new macroeconomic regime is driving differentiated repricing across financial assets.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled: BRICS Summit clash pushes 57th meet to October 7
Data & Insights.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting has been rescheduled from September 12 to October 7 due to a scheduling conflict with the BRICS Summit. The upcoming meeting is expected to address pending tax issues, including input tax credit, corporate guarantees, and rate rationalisation.

India.title: After Delhi PG Collapse, Lt Governor Orders Student Housing Audit In A Week
India.summary: Following a paying guest (PG) building collapse in Delhi, the Lieutenant Governor has ordered a safety audit of all student housing within a week. The incident highlights the heavy reliance on private accommodations due to limited university hostel capacity.

India.title: Delhi PG Building Collapse: 5 Officials Suspended, Court Orders High-Level Inquiry
India.summary: Seven people died when a boys' paying guest building near Delhi University's South Campus collapsed during repair work. Five officials have been suspended and a court has ordered a high-level inquiry into the incident.

India.title: Newborn Dies After Ambulance Gets Stuck For 2 Hours On Damaged Road In UP
India.summary: A newborn baby died in Uttar Pradesh after an ambulance carrying the infant got stuck on a damaged road for two hours. Villagers eventually had to use a tractor to pull the ambulance out of the mud.

India.title: Gift Amid Grief: Delhi Building Collapse Victim's Family Donates His Corneas
India.summary: Following the tragic death of their son Arpit in a Delhi building collapse, his grieving family donated his corneas. This selfless decision ensures that Arpit's gift will help others regain their sight.

India.title: Baba Ramdev's Aide Balkrishna Acquitted In 15-Year Old Forged Documents Case
India.summary: A CBI court has acquitted Baba Ramdev's aide Acharya Balkrishna in a 15-year-old forged documents case. The court also acquitted a co-accused, Naresh Chandra Dwivedi, who was charged with providing the forged documents to Balkrishna.

India.title: Ground Report | Sunlight Is A Luxury In Delhi Students' Hub Where Building Collapse Killed 7
India.summary: A building collapse in Delhi's Satya Niketan student hub killed seven people due to failing civic infrastructure. Overcrowding from an influx of tenants and landlord greed have caused the area's development to crumble.

General.title: Minister condemns disorder at Portsmouth anti-migrant protest after police officers hurt
General.summary: Minister Sarah Jones condemned the violence at a Portsmouth anti-migrant protest after police officers were hurt. She described the disorder, sparked by the arrival of 120 migrants in a single dinghy, as "intimidating and thuggish."

General.title: What we know about anti-migrant protests and organiser Danny Thomas
General.summary: Over the weekend, anti-migrant protests involving small boat demonstrations took place in Dover and Portsmouth. UK correspondent Daniel Sandford is reporting on these events and examining the role of organizer Danny Thomas.

General.title: King makes clear Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals
General.summary: Buckingham Palace has clarified that Prince Harry and Meghan Markle will not return as working royals. Palace sources confirm that an official letter detailing this status has been sent to government, military, and royal officials.

General.title: Faisal Islam: Chancellor's attempts to boost vibes may limit tax rises
General.summary: The new leadership is attempting to maintain economic confidence and promote growth. These efforts to boost market sentiment may limit upcoming tax increases.

General.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over next two years
General.summary: Jaguar Land Rover will cut 4,000 jobs over the next two years. The carmaker is struggling with Chinese competition, US tariffs, and the transition to electric vehicles.

General.title: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
General.summary: A headteacher in the occupied West Bank installed new barbed wire fencing to protect students following the deaths of three pupils in settler attacks this year. Palestinian parents are increasingly fearful for their children's lives at school as these violent incidents grow.
